en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. It was narrated to me by Ali b. Ahmad from his grandfather Ahmad b. Abdillah from his father from Muhammad b. Khalid from al-Muffadhal b. Umar from al-Sadiq (a.s.) who said: “
Two rakat prayer prayed with perfume is equal to seventy rakat prayer offered without perfume.”
